definitions.explanation: The paired punctuation marks { and }, used in mathematics, programming, and formal writing to group items at a middle level of nesting between parentheses and square brackets. Also called {波括弧|なみかっこ} ("wave brackets"), especially in programming contexts.

examples.japanese: {中括弧|なかかっこ}で{囲|かこ}む。
{数式|すうしき}に{中括弧|なかかっこ}を{使|つか}ってグループ{分|わ}けする。
examples.english: Use curly brackets to group parts of a mathematical expression.

examples.japanese: プログラミングでは、{中括弧|なかかっこ}で{関数|かんすう}のブロックを{示|しめ}す{言語|げんご}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In programming, many languages use curly brackets to mark the block of a function.

examples.japanese: {大括弧|だいかっこ}、{中括弧|なかかっこ}、{小括弧|しょうかっこ}の{順|じゅん}に、{外側|そとがわ}から{内側|うちがわ}へ{括弧|かっこ}が{並|なら}ぶのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common for brackets to be nested in the order of square brackets, curly brackets, then parentheses, from outside to inside.

notes:
Composed of {中|なか} (middle) and {括弧|かっこ} (bracket, parenthesis). Refers to the { } symbols.

USAGE:
{中括弧|なかかっこ} is the mathematical/formal name, based on a nesting order: {小括弧|しょうかっこ} ( ) as innermost, {中括弧|なかかっこ} { } as middle, {大括弧|だいかっこ} [ ] as outermost. (Note: some systems reverse this order — see below.) In programming and computing contexts, the bracket { } is very often called {波括弧|なみかっこ} ("wave brackets") or simply {ブレース}.

BRACKET NAMES:
- {小括弧|しょうかっこ}: ( ) — parentheses (smallest)
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}: { } — curly brackets (middle)
- {大括弧|だいかっこ}: [ ] — square brackets (largest)

Note: The size names refer to the conventional nesting order in Japanese mathematical notation. In English mathematical tradition the order is usually the opposite (parentheses → square → curly), so translating in context matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}で{囲|かこ}む: to enclose in curly brackets
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}を{開|ひら}く / {閉|と}じる: to open / close a curly bracket
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}の{中|なか}: inside the curly brackets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {括弧|かっこ}: bracket, parenthesis — general term
- {波括弧|なみかっこ}: curly bracket — common name in programming contexts
- ブレース: brace — loanword, used in programming
